about: The source line already carried a pointer to idea-mara-lighthouse from an earlier run; the writer later changed its tag to committed, so it is new work (spec-run-manager.md 07.1 item 4). This run graduates it into area-mara with its tag dropped (migrator-rules.md 03.7), and the Run manager adds area-mara to the existing pointer (spec-run-manager.md 08.2 item 3). Only what the Run manager added since the snapshot is stripped, and only the added destination is checked against the unit's copies (spec-edit-guard.md 03.1 item 5; 03.3 item 2). The record's source text is the line as it read at run start, earlier pointer included. No flags.
